boundary: Dedicated local PostgreSQL 16 database; synthetic tables/identities with real native RPC bodies extracted unchanged. Existing live business RLS/FCM/Google were not exercised. Concurrent tests use two physical connections.

checks.label: private redactor removes whole compact/formatted identifiers and raw JWT before base phone masking
private schema/helper/payload has no authenticated or anon privileges
admin and gestor create notes, operator/read denied without manage; leitura with explicit venue grant works
proposal is side-effect free; authorized exact note preview is absent in direct SELECT
known PII/secrets/token links, forbidden action kinds and client success/capability fields rejected by SQL
proposal request replay is stable and mismatched reuse is rejected
edit regenerates exact diff/revision and stale revision never executes
cancel and expiry are terminal, audited and wipe private plaintext
cross-user/org and stale membership denied; raw RLS hides revoked target access
snapshot change refuses effects and edit obtains a new valid snapshot
commercial manual form is mandatory/private; reserve and negotiate call native RPCs with optional fields NULL
AVAILABLE with active opposite operation, sale or order contract is refused without cancellation
deep links use persisted venue type ancestry and exact lot UUID; target labels mask before truncation
manual request replay is idempotent; no private fields or secrets can escape its exact SQL schema
two physical connections confirming one note commit exactly one effect/receipt
two distinct cards on one lot cannot create two commercial effects
concurrent cancel wins before confirm without a business effect
concurrent edit invalidates the waiting confirmation revision
capability revoked while confirm waits for card lock is revalidated and refused
expiry is checked after waiting on target locks, not transaction start
an additional native trigger wait past expiry rolls back the late business effect
failure after native business RPC rolls back business/history and exposes no SQL secret
lock wait is bounded and replay with the same proposal remains safe
admission rate cap rejects excess proposals before business effects
